steps: Create one premium 3D product illustration for a mobile astrology app. A luxurious original wristwatch branded exactly NEBOX, engraved discreetly on its dial. No Rolex words or crown logo. Polished platinum and champagne gold bracelet, elegant round deep emerald teal dial. Instead of hour numbers, twelve distinct gold zodiac glyphs arranged around the dial. Refined mechanical watch, beautiful reflections and dimensional machining, aspirational contemporary luxury, not cartoon. Entire watch with loosely curved bracelet seen at a three quarter angle, face clearly visible, tilted slightly clockwise, floating. Transparent background, no floor, no rectangle, no additional text. Square composition, object fills 85 percent of canvas, crisp silhouette. Designed to sit over a mint and lavender app card.

Edit this watch asset. Change only the engraved brand name on the green dial from NEBOX to exactly NEBO, four letters N E B O, no X. Preserve the beautiful original watch, zodiac glyphs, materials, camera angle, full bracelet silhouette and transparent background. No other text, no background. The output is a transparent product cutout; the app adds its own colored background and shows the watch at a small size.
